If it wasn't for you, I'd wake up at the Prontera Church!

it's terrible... I don't want to... think about it again...

anyways, apart from that terrible story... you saved me here...

总之，抛开那个可怕的故事不谈...你在这里救了我...

[Dew]

Isn't this place awesome???

Let's go up!!!
Now!!

快！！

Without me too...

scripts.text: Bang!!!

This way...

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you very much. But I'm afraid that I'm taking too much of your time {0}... If you don't mind at all, I'd like to ask you a favor.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
非常感谢。但恐怕我占用您太多时间了，{0}...如果您不介意的话，我想请您帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
请给我^0000CD10个自动人偶通讯芯片^000000用于中继器。我想这应该够维持几天的用量了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring it's communication chips with you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
这也有助于解决在宅邸中游荡的故障自动人偶的问题。请处理在宅邸中游荡的故障贝塔，并带上它们的通讯芯片。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Then, please adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
那么，拜托了，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Did you bring the Automatic Doll Communication Chips that I asked for?
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
您带来了我要求的自动人偶通讯芯片吗？

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Please bring me ^0000CD10 Automatic Doll Communication Chips^000000 for the repeater. I think that will be enough for the days supply.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
请给我^0000CD10个自动人偶通讯芯片^000000用于中继器。我想这应该够维持几天的用量了。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
It also help us with the broken automatic dolls roaming around the mansion. Please take care of any Broken Betas roaming around the mansion and bring its communication chips with you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
这也有助于解决在宅邸中游荡的故障自动人偶的问题。请处理在宅邸中游荡的故障贝塔，并带上它们的通讯芯片。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
This is enough for the day. Thank you for your hard work.
If you have time, I'd like to ask for your help again ^0000CDafter dawn^000000, If you don't mind please come again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
今天的用量足够了。感谢您的辛勤工作。
如果您有时间，^0000CD黎明之后^000000我还想再请您帮忙。如果不介意，请明天再来。

scripts.text:
[Mansion Manager ��]
Thank you very much. Please take this with you.
scripts.translation:
[管理员]
非常感谢。请收下这个。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品数量过多，无法继续对话。
请整理您的背包后重试。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Ugh! Now, wait. What is that? Tch, the intruder?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
呜！等等。那是什么？切，是入侵者吗？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
That's right! That's right! Oh, what should I do? What do I do, What do I do? Security? Oh, yeah. I was told to call security.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
没错！没错！哎呀，我该怎么办？我该怎么办，我该怎么办？保安？对了。我被告知要呼叫保安。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What? It's not working! When did it break down? Oh, what do I do?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
什么？不工作！什么时候坏的？哎呀，我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Yeah! Mochi! I'll give you a piece of Mochi, so why don't we go somewhere else? You like mochi, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
对！甜米糕！我给你一块甜米糕，我们要不去别的地方？你喜欢甜米糕，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, it's not mochi? Aren't you the guy I met before? Then, meat? Do you like meat? You like meat, don't you? I've never seen anyone who doesn't like meat. I'll give you all the meat I have.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
哦，不是甜米糕？你不是我之前见过的那个家伙吗？那么，肉？你喜欢肉吗？你喜欢肉，对吧？我从来没见过不喜欢肉的人。我把所有的肉都给你。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Strange? It's not meat? Then what can I get you? Do you want to go back?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
奇怪？不是肉？那我还能给你什么？你想回去吗？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, what should I do? I was told not to run to the intruders. Are you here to ^0000CDtake my parts^000000? Is this the end of me?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
哎呀，我该怎么办？我被告知不要跑向入侵者。你是来^0000CD拆我的零件^000000的吗？这就是我的结局吗？

scripts.text: I'm not that kind of person.
scripts.translation: 我不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
You're not that kind of person...? Then, what kind of person are you?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你不是那种人...？那么，你是哪种人？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Hold on...? You're right? You're not drooling, and your eyes are normal. Are you not an ^0000CDintruder^000000?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
等等...？你说得对？你没有流口水，眼睛也很正常。你不是^0000CD入侵者^000000吗？

scripts.text: I'm a guest of the mansion, but...
scripts.translation: 我是宅邸的客人，但是...

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What? A guest? Oh wait. I'll check...
scripts.translation:
[美味]
什么？客人？哦等等。我查一下...

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
It's real? But... You're a first time guest? New guest? Finally? Oh, I'm sorry for mistaking you as an intruder.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
是真的？但是...你是第一次来的客人？新客人？终于？哦，抱歉把你误认为入侵者了。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I thought you were one of the intruder.
Somehow, everyone said they were running away, it's because of you, the new guests, right?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
我以为你是入侵者之一。
不知为何，大家都说他们在逃跑，是因为你，新客人，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What's your relationship with the intruder? Are we natural enemies? Which way is above the pyramid? The intruders is running away, so it's your fault?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你和入侵者是什么关系？我们是天敌吗？金字塔的哪边是上面？入侵者在逃跑，所以是你的错？

scripts.text: It's not like that.
scripts.translation: 不是那样的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, really? I didn't know because it's been so long since I saw a human being.
So why didn't I recognize a guest? All new guests would have been shared to us.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
哦，真的吗？因为很久没见过人类了，所以我不知道。
那我为什么没认出客人？所有新客人的信息都会共享给我们。

scripts.text: The repeater is broken, so...
scripts.translation: 中继器坏了，所以...

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, no wonder! The network stopped working suddenly. The repeater is not functioning! Then why isn't Alpha coming?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
哦，难怪！网络突然停止工作了。中继器不工作！那为什么阿尔法没来？

scripts.text: Alpha is busy right now.
scripts.translation: 阿尔法现在很忙。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Alpha is too busy to come? No way. Oh, were you trying to help me voluntarily? What an unusual guest. Come to think of it, there was a^0000CDcustomer like that before^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
阿尔法太忙了所以来不了？不可能。哦，你是想主动帮我吗？真是位特别的客人。仔细想想，之前也有过^0000CD这样的客人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I'm sorry.
The guest who visited the mansion showed interest in the mansion and us automatic dolls, but there were no guests who helped us around the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
抱歉。
之前来别墅的客人虽然对别墅和我们自动人偶很感兴趣，但并没有客人帮我们在别墅里忙活。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Anyway, If we have a lot of guests, they'll be coming to eat soon. I've got to prepare. It's been a long time since I've had guests.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
总之，既然来了很多客人，他们很快就会来吃饭。我得去准备了。已经很久没有客人了。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I haven't had any guests in the restaurant for a long time. I had no customer when I was cooking. The intruders... when they got here. My eyes change and I took them away. They were not guests.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
餐厅已经很久没有客人了。我做饭的时候没有顾客。那些入侵者...当他们来到这里时。我的眼睛变了，我把他们赶走了。他们不是客人。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
The invaders didn't last long, but they threw the mansion into chaos in that brief moment. They took the machines in the mansion, the automatic dools, everything that seemed useful to them were removed out of place.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
入侵者没待多久，但在那短暂的时间里，他们把别墅搞得一团糟。他们拿走了别墅里的机器、自动人偶，所有看起来有用的东西都被他们拆得七零八落。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
That repeater over there must have a ^0000CDbroken communication chip too^000000?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
那边的中继器肯定也是^0000CD通讯芯片坏了^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Damn humans. Most of them seems to have run away by now, but there are still some left. I've seen them here a few times. They're after the food.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
该死的人类。大部分似乎已经逃跑了，但还是有一些留在这里。我见过他们几次。他们是冲着食物来的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Again, I'm sorry.
Now that I see it, I don't know why I mistaken you as an intruder. You're different.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
再次抱歉。
现在看清楚了，我不知道为什么之前把你误认为入侵者。你和他们不一样。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Anyway, I have to fix the repeater. Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[美味]
总之，我得修理那个中继器。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Well... the communication chip was ripped off! I'll have to put it in. Where should we get it right now? I have to greet guests?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
嗯...通讯芯片被扯掉了！我得把它装回去。现在去哪里找呢？我得去迎接客人？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Ugh- There's another broken one over there.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
唉——那边还有一个坏掉的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
{0}. Can you catch that? Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
{0}。你能抓住那个吗？你能做到吗？

scripts.text: A broken automatic doll?
scripts.translation: 坏掉的自动人偶？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Uh. All communication chips are standard, so if they're replaced with a new one. I think it'll return back to normal.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
嗯。所有的通讯芯片都是标准的，所以如果换成一个新的。我想它会恢复正常。

scripts.text: Uh...

[Tasty]
Why do you look like that? Is it because you're reluctant to hurt an automatic doll in front of another one? Don't worry about that.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你为什么那样看？是因为你不好意思在另一个自动人偶面前伤害它吗？别担心。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
We need to repair it anyway, but we need to capture it first.
You can think of it as saving the trouble for us automatic dolls.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
我们反正需要修理它，但我们需要先抓住它。
你可以把它看作是在帮我们自动人偶省事。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
If you leave it alone, it will wander around the mansion and destroy it, so you'll have to deal with it quickly as you can.
It's better to capture it, then take out the chip and use it to fix the repeater.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
如果不管它，它会在别墅里四处游荡并破坏东西，所以你得尽快处理。
最好抓住它，然后取出芯片用来修理中继器。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Everyone has been doing that ever since the intruders showed up. Even if {0} doesn't do it, it's all up to us automatic dolls.
It's nice to work a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
自从入侵者出现后，大家一直都在做这种事。即使{0}不做，也全得靠我们自动人偶。
能帮上一点忙挺好的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Please take care of the Broken Beta and bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
请处理好损坏的贝塔，并带回来一块^0000CD1自动人偶通讯芯片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What about the communication chip?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
通讯芯片找到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
You haven't yet? Are you reluctant to hurt an automatic doll? Don't worry about it. I will do it later on anyway.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
还没吗？你是因为不忍心伤害自动人偶吗？别担心，反正之后我会处理它的。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
I'll take care of the broken automatic dolls, just bring ^0000CD1 Automatic Doll Communication Chip^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
损坏的自动人偶交给我处理，你只需要带回来一块^0000CD1自动人偶通讯芯片^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Did you bring it? Give it to me. I'll fix it. Thank you very much for bringing it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
带回来了吗？给我吧，我会修好的。非常感谢你带回来。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
By the way, is that the only broken repeater?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
顺便问一下，那是唯一损坏的中继器吗？

scripts.text: The pavilion and the garden...
scripts.translation: 凉亭和花园...

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Oh, really? Then go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
哦，是吗？那就先去<NAVI>[凉亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。这里是离得最近的。沿着这条路走就行。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
不要随意触碰损坏的中继器。告诉那边附近的自动人偶，让它们来处理。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Do you happen to have a Barmeal Ticket? It's use to eat at the restaurant. I'll give you this, so come and eat later! I'll prepare a good food for you! As thanks!
scripts.translation:
[美味]
你身上有霸肋门德餐券吗？那是用来在餐厅吃饭的。我把这个给你，之后来吃饭吧！我会为你准备美味的食物！作为感谢！

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Go ahead to the <NAVI>[pavilion]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI> first. It's the closest one here. Just follow this road over here.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
先去<NAVI>[凉亭]<INFO>ba_maison,334,143,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。这里是离得最近的。沿着这条路走就行。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
Don't touch the broken repeater carelessly. Tell the nearby automatic dolls over there and they'll take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[美味]
不要随意触碰损坏的中继器。告诉那边附近的自动人偶，让它们来处理。

scripts.text:
[Tasty]
What should I make today... What should I do to make it taste good?
scripts.translation:
[美味]
今天该做什么菜呢...怎么做才能好吃呢？

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
由于您携带的物品过多，无法再接收任何物品。请在减轻负重后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's no one here...? What should I do with this? Is the automatic doll communication chip broken again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没有人...？这东西该怎么办？自动人偶通讯芯片又坏了吗...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What if I open this...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我打开这个...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh!!!! My hand!!

[Worry]
This...! What a mess! Here we go again! It wants to fight.
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
这...！真是一团糟！又来了！它想打架。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
Get out of my head right now!
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
立刻从我脑子里滚出去！

scripts.text: Over there...
scripts.translation: 在那边...

scripts.text:
[Worry]
Are you trying to control me?
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
你想控制我吗？

scripts.text:
[Worry]
This little thing! I'll dispose of it!
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
这个小东西！我要消灭它！

scripts.text:
[Worry]
Are you trying to take over me?? Just try!!
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
你想控制我吗？！试试看啊！

scripts.text: What should I do? Should I just go?
scripts.translation: 我该怎么办？就这样离开吗？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Phew- Here you are. Why do you keep escaping? Calm down for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
呼——你来了。为什么一直逃跑呢？冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Anyway, who...? An intruder? ...Is it not?
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
总之，那是谁...？入侵者？...不，应该不是吧？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, you're a guest, aren't you? Those who come and go in front of the pavilion are also guests.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
啊，你是客人吧？在亭子前来来去去的人，也都是客人。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
But that's weird. If you're a guest, I would recognize you in an instance.
You are not an unregistered guest, you're a regular guest here.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
但这很奇怪。如果是客人，我一眼就能认出来。
你不是未登记的客人，而是这里的常客。

scripts.text: They can't share it because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 因为中继器，他们无法共享。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, it's because of that! Everytime time I find something broken, I'll repair it, but as you can see, even if I take my eyes out for a moment, Wary comes out and break it like this.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
啊，是因为那个啊！每次我发现坏掉的东西，我都会修复它，但正如你所见，只要我稍微走开一会儿，瓦里就会出来把它弄坏成这样。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, did our hawk bit you? It's been going on since he was attacked by the ^0000CDintruders^000000. I already fixed it before, but Wary always come out and does this...
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
哦，是我们的鹰咬了你吗？自从它被^0000CD入侵者^000000攻击后，就一直这样。我之前已经修好了，但瓦里总是出来弄坏它...

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
There are a lot of dolls that became like this.
They will return to normal if you fix it, but there are so many dolls that we are a hard time fixing all of them.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
有很多玩偶都变成了这样。
如果你修复它们，它们就会恢复正常，但玩偶太多了，我们很难全部修好。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I heard the hawks wander around the mansion and ruin it.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
我听说鹰会在别墅里四处游荡，把东西弄坏。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I'm sorry to interrupt you at your break. Please enjoy this area of the Varmundt's mansion to your hearts content.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
抱歉打扰你休息了。请尽情享用瓦尔蒙特别墅的这个区域吧。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
How can this thing be this lively.
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
这东西怎么这么活泼。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
You, are you going to get out of my head or not? If you won't then I'll go out!
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
你，到底要不要从我脑子里出去？如果你不出去，我就出去！

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Hey, hey. Why are you opening the repeater?
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
嘿，嘿。你为什么要打开中继器？

scripts.text: Oh, you need to fix it quickly.
scripts.translation: 哦，你需要尽快修好它。

scripts.text:
[Worry]
What the hell are you? Are you pitying me?
scripts.translation:
[忧心]
你到底是什么东西？是在可怜我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Hey, this person is not an intruder. It's our guest. Let them enjoy here in the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
嘿，这个人不是入侵者。他是我们的客人。让他们在别墅里尽情享用吧。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
I'll fix the repeater quickly. Wary will surely come out and destroy it, but don't worry we can fix it again.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
我会尽快修好中继器。瓦里肯定会出来把它弄坏，但别担心，我们可以再修好它。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Thank you for letting me know in person. Here, atleast, take this. Are there any other places where it doesn't work? I don't think there's only one or two places.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
谢谢你亲自告诉我。来，至少收下这个。还有其他地方不工作吗？我觉得不止一两处。

scripts.text: The garden in front of the mansion.
scripts.translation: 别墅前的花园

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Oh, it's not working there either.
Go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
那里也不管用。
沿着这条路往上走，然后左转前往<NAVI>[中央花园]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Kimchi]
Come on, Warry. Let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[泡菜]
好了，瓦里，我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The doll told me to go up from this road and turn left to go to the <NAVI>[central garden]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
玩偶让我沿着这条路往上走，然后左转前往<NAVI>[中央花园]<INFO>ba_maison,245,206,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
如果这是最后一个，请向<NAVI>[阿尔法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>汇报。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
May I help you?
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
Please return to the entrance.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
有什么事吗？
此处仅限授权人员进入。
请返回入口。

scripts.text:
The number of items in your possession is too high, so you cannot proceed with the conversation.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
您持有的物品数量过多，无法继续对话。
请整理您的背包后重试。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Hello, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
你好，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Don't come any closer.
This place is accessible only to authorized personnels.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
不要靠近。
此处仅限授权人员进入。

scripts.text: Oh, I am...
scripts.translation: 哦，我是...

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
I'm not concern about that. I don't need to know anything about you. This place is restricted. Raise your hands and don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
我不关心这个。我不需要了解你的任何信息。这是限制区域。举起双手，不要靠近。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Don't even think about using weapons, I'm way faster than you are. Where did you come from?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
别想着使用武器，我比你快得多。你从哪里来的？

scripts.text: The sewer, but I...
scripts.translation: 下水道，但是...

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
So you came from the sewers, huh. Then stand still until I hand you over to the security.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
原来你是从下水道来的啊。那就站在那别动，等我把你移交给保安。

scripts.text: I'm a guest at the mansion.
scripts.translation: 我是别墅的客人。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
A guest? If you are one I would have known.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
客人？如果是客人的话，我应该知道的。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
I will check it for a moment. Don't move from your spot.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
我查一下。不要离开你的位置。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Oh, you're a real guest aren't you? You're a special guest who has permission to access all areas... I apologize for my mistake. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
哦，你真是客人啊。你是拥有所有区域通行权限的特邀嘉宾...我为我的失误道歉。请原谅我。

scripts.text: I can't believe it. You suddenly attacked me.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信。你突然袭击了我。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Attack? Did I attack? I only responded according to the intruder response manual. Oh, did you felt like you were attacked?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
袭击？我袭击了吗？我只是按照入侵者应对手册行事而已。哦，你感觉像是被袭击了吗？

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 没有...

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Once again, I apologize for my mistake.
Recently, we guards are more suspicious and sharper because of the intruders. Also, among the them there is a man with a low profile that appeared and resisted strongly.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
再次为我的失误道歉。
最近，由于入侵者的出现，我们卫兵变得更加警惕和敏锐。而且，其中有一个低姿态的男子，他出现了并进行了强烈的抵抗。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
By the way, how were you able to get permission to access all areas? Normally, ordinary guests can only use non-restricted areas.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
顺便问一下，你是如何获得所有区域的通行权限的？通常，普通访客只能使用非限制区域。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If you were such a distinguished guest, I should have received your information much earlier.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
如果你是这样尊贵的客人，我应该早就收到你的信息了。

scripts.text: It's because of the repeater.
scripts.translation: 是因为中继器。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
The repeater? The repeater here is working fine...
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
中继器？这里的中继器运行正常...

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Wait, this isn't a signal problem, suddenly there's a ^0000CDhacking channel^000000 jamming it... right?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
等等，这不是信号问题，突然有一个^0000CD黑客频道^000000在干扰它...对吧？

scripts.text: Hacking?
scripts.translation: 黑客？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Knowing that the automatic dolls in the mansion send and receive signals throught the repeater. Sometimes, people ^0000CDhack the repeater^000000 to try to control the automatic dolls or to keep track of what's happening inside the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
既然知道宅邸里的自动人偶是通过中继器发送和接收信号的。有时候，人们会^0000CD黑入中继器^000000，试图控制自动人偶，或者追踪宅邸内发生的情况。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
There are still intruders left inside the mansion.
I must search thoroughly.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
宅邸里还有入侵者。
我必须彻底搜查。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Previously, the intruders were alerted because of a guest who wandered around the mansion, thinking there were no such guest int the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
之前，入侵者是因为一位在宅邸里四处游荡、以为没有这种客人的访客而警觉的。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
But that doesn't change the fact that they're intruders. Unlike the previous guest who were just curious, they infiltrated the premises and commited all kinds of violence in the mansion. Don't you think they're like a thief?
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
但这并不改变他们是入侵者的事实。与之前只是好奇的访客不同，他们潜入禁区并在宅邸内实施了各种暴力行为。你不觉得他们像盗贼吗？

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
{0}, If you don't want to be misunderstood by the other automatic dolls in the mansion, especially in the vicinity of restricted areas, you should identify yourself in advance.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
{0}，如果你不想被宅邸里的其他自动人偶误解，特别是在限制区域附近，你应该提前表明身份。

scripts.text: This is the last.
scripts.translation: 这是最后一个。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
Is that so? Then I'll have to hurry and the repeater, please excuse me.
Also, it's not much but please accept this as an apology.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
是吗？那我得赶紧去处理中继器了，请原谅我。
另外，这点小礼物请收下，作为我的道歉。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>. Also... Welcome to the Varmundt's Mansion. If you need assistance, feel free to ask any automatic doll.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
如果这是最后一个，请向<NAVI>[阿尔法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>汇报。另外...欢迎来到瓦尔蒙特宅邸。如果需要帮助，请随时询问任何自动人偶。

scripts.text:
[Gabriel]
If this is the last one, please report back to <NAVI>[Alpha]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[加布里埃尔]
如果这是最后一个，请向<NAVI>[阿尔法]<INFO>ba_maison,74,150,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>汇报。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Can you meet Alpha first and then come back here at the teahouse?
It seems that the first thing you need to do here is register yourself as a guest.
- A preceding quest still exist. -
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你能先去找阿尔法，然后回到这里的茶室吗？
看起来你在这里需要做的第一件事是登记为访客。
- 之前的任务仍然存在。 -

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Dien, please check the authenticity again.
This is a document that the goverment examined when the mercenaries stayed here at the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
迪恩，请再次核实真实性。
这是政府审查雇佣兵在瓦尔蒙特宅邸停留时的一份文件。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well... even if tried to check the authenticity many times.
I'm not sure to what extent our cooperation will go.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯...即使尝试了多次核实真实性。
我不确定我们的合作能进行到什么程度。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm a bit tired of saying the same thing over and over again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我有点厌倦了反复说同样的话。

scripts.text: (The mood looks bad, Let's observe for now.)
scripts.translation: (气氛看起来不太好，先观察一下。)

scripts.text:
[Tess]
If you take a look, you'll be to understand this evidence.
It's a proof that the goverment tried to talk to the mercenaries, but they didn't respond to it.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
如果你看一下，就能理解这个证据了。
这是政府试图与雇佣兵沟通，但他们没有回应的证明。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That kind of talk never happened! Not a single soul from the government came to talk you know?
I already said no, how long will you keep asking me to find out the truth like a parrot?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
根本没有什么对话！政府那边没有一个人来找过我们，你知道吗？
我已经说过很多次了，你还要像鹦鹉一样一直追问真相吗？

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
It's the same when you brought us new documents, you're lying!
You've been lying to us several times already!
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
你们带来新文件的时候也是一样的，你们在撒谎！
你们已经骗过我们好几次了！

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Why would you think that we'll deliberately use false documents...!
Ah, {0}, since when have you been here? I've shown you a shameful side of me.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你为什么会认为我们会故意使用伪造的文件...！
啊，{0}，你什么时候来的？让你看到我不体面的一面了。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but it's difficult to verify events that happened in the past...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我正在和反叛者<NAVI>[长老们]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>交谈，但很难核实过去发生的事件...

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm talking with the Rebellion <NAVI>[Elders]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>, but they're quite stubborn, perhaps because they're already seniors.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我正在和反叛者<NAVI>[长老们]<INFO>ba_in01,203,103,0,0,0</INFO></NAVI>交谈，但他们相当固执，也许是因为他们年纪大了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Hey! Who are you calling seniors?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
嘿！谁年纪大了？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
冒险者，请去见见宅邸的管理员，调查一下雇佣兵在瓦尔蒙特宅邸停留期间发生的事情。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If you're looking for a high-quality tea, this mansion is the place you're looking for.
The tea that I'm drinking in Einbech is not bad, but it's incomparable from the tea here.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果你在找高品质的茶，这里就是你要找的地方。
我在艾音贝赫喝的茶还不错，但和这里的茶相比简直不值一提。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Hmm... Hey, gentleman from the government. Why do you keep asking for evidence when you don't believe what we're saying?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯...嘿，政府的那位先生。既然你不相信我们说的话，为什么还要一直索要证据？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let's bring a false documents to the mercenaries and ask them to prove every mistakes. We can't say anything about that.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
让我们把伪造的文件交给雇佣兵，让他们指出所有的错误。对此我们无话可说。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's a waste of time.
I'd rather find another way, instead of wasting my time doing something contradictory.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
这是浪费时间。
我宁愿找其他方法，也不愿浪费时间做这种自相矛盾的事。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
... what else could there be, other than to examine the records and write report.
Are you saying that you can't believe goverment-made report unconditionally?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...除了审查记录并撰写报告，还能有什么呢？
你是说你不能无条件地相信政府制作的报告吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
For a minute, could you listen to me?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请听我说一分钟，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The question is, isn't it the credibility of the record itself?
No matter how much we use that record with mixed opinions, we won't be able to reach an agreement.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
问题在于，记录本身的可靠性不是吗？
无论我们如何带着不同意见使用那份记录，我们都无法达成一致。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
...as a result, this happened.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
...结果，就发生了这样的事。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So instead of relying on the government records, why don't we investigate the events that really happened here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以，与其依赖政府记录，我们为什么不调查一下这里真正发生的事件呢？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This place is the base of the Mercenaries War, If you investigate it with your own eyes, you might see things you haven't seen before.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这里是雇佣兵战争的大本营，如果你亲眼调查一下，可能会看到以前没看到的东西。

scripts.text: It's a good idea.
scripts.translation: 这是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, who can remember exactly and vividly what occurred here?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那么，谁能准确且生动地回忆起这里发生的事情呢？

scripts.text: The Mansion Manager.
scripts.translation: 宅邸管理员

scripts.text: The Cleaning Robots.
scripts.translation: 清洁机器人

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, cleaning robots only response to what people say.
Ah, yes. The mansion managers would remember it!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，清洁机器人只会回应人们的言语。
啊，对了。宅邸管理员应该会记得！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Yes, the Varmundt Mansion Managers! It's not human, but it probably a more neutral source of data.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
是的，瓦尔蒙特宅邸的管理员！它们不是人类，但可能是更中立的资料来源。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Lucky, Why aren't you listening to us and taking the government's side?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
拉基，你为什么不听我们的，而站在政府那边？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
It's a reasonable way. But who will witness it?
If I said I would, you wouldn't believe me.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
这是合理的做法。但谁来见证呢？
如果我说我会，你不会相信我的。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If the government is asking me to believe the lies they've been building until now, then I can't cooperate with you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果政府要求我相信他们至今编造的谎言，那我无法与你们合作。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
How would you know if the government really tried to talk to the mercenaries, also how would you know that the mercenaries rejected it. You're just bringing us evidence that none of us have know.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你怎么知道政府真的试图与佣兵谈判，又怎么知道佣兵拒绝了？你们只是拿来了我们谁都不知道证据。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The elders wouldn't even go out to investigate themselves...,
Adventurer, you're the only one that the elders will believe.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
长老们甚至不愿亲自出去调查...
冒险者，你是长老们唯一会相信的人。

scripts.text: I'll get their permission.
scripts.translation: 我会去征得他们的同意。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I can believe what the adventurer done so far.
Will you listen to the managers for us, adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我可以相信冒险者迄今为止所做的事。
冒险者，你愿意替我们听听管理员的话吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
The existence of the adventurer is very important to both parties and invaluable in this place where various enemy forces are in motion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
在这个各方敌对势力蠢蠢欲动的地方，冒险者的存在对双方都非常重要且无可估量。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Adventurer, please go to the managers of the mansion and find out what happened about the time when the mercenaries stayed here in Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
冒险者，请去见见宅邸的管理员，调查一下雇佣兵在瓦尔蒙特宅邸停留期间发生的事情。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Are you busy or it's just a bad time?
Don't you like what I asked you to do?
I can't force you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
你是太忙了，还是时机不对？
你不喜欢我让你做的事吗？
我不能强迫你去做。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
谢谢你，冒险者。看来你又得接手麻烦的工作了。
我期待由中立第三方给出的真相。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Thank you, adventurer. It seems you're left with the troublesome work again.
I look forward to the truth that is given by a neutral party.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
谢谢你，冒险者。看来你又得接手麻烦的工作了。
我期待由中立第三方给出的真相。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The managers knows the truth about the mercenary war.
They're all automatic dolls, they will have a vivid memory and they won't tell lies.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
管理员知道雇佣兵战争的真相。
它们都是自动人偶，拥有清晰的记忆，而且不会说谎。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Please listen to the stories of those days, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
请听听那些日子的故事，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Have you heard enough from the managers?
Now, tell us about the facts that you've heard.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你从管理员那里听够了吗？
现在，告诉我们你听到的事实。

scripts.text: Tell the story of the mysterious body.
scripts.translation: 讲述神秘尸体的故事

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There is a body suddenly, What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
突然出现了一具尸体，你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It is said that the body that was found was not of the mercenaries, mansion's staff, or part of the corporate... Do you have any specific information?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
据说发现的尸体既不是佣兵的，也不是宅邸职员的，更不是公司的一部分...你有具体的信息吗？

scripts.text: Hand over specific data.
scripts.translation: 提供具体数据

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
This person doesn't really look like a mercenary. Why would a person like this be near Varmundt Mansion and be killed?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
这个人看起来完全不像佣兵。为什么一个这样的人会出现在瓦尔蒙特宅邸附近，并且被杀害了？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Wait... Show me the data too.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
等等...把数据也给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Is there something bothering you about this data?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
这份数据有什么让你困扰的地方吗？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
We know who this person is.
This person is one of the commissioner the government sent to the mercenaries for the negotiation.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我们知道这个人是谁。
他是政府派去与佣兵进行谈判的专员之一。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
It's said that the commissioner didn't come back after being sent, the commissioner was later presumed as a missing person.
But, later found dead in the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
据说这位专员被派出去后就没有回来，后来被认定为失踪。
但后来却在瓦尔蒙特宅邸发现了他的尸体。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
So, you're saying... A government official who went to see the mercenaries, was killed before even meeting the mercenaries...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
所以，你的意思是...一位去见佣兵的政府官员，在见到佣兵之前就被杀害了...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This, who did such thing.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这...是谁做的。

scripts.text: The Enterprise.
scripts.translation: 企业

scripts.text: The Government.
scripts.translation: 政府

scripts.text: The Mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 佣兵

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
...There is no evidence, adventurer.
Your words gives me heartaches.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...没有证据，冒险者。
你的话让我很心痛。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We should talk more carefully.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我们应该更谨慎地交谈。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Why would someone from the government kill the one they sent?
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
政府为什么要杀害自己派去的人？

scripts.text:
[Tess]
Even if it's the government's opposition, it would have been difficult to commit murder without escaping the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers inside the Varmundt Mansion.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
即使是政府的反对派，要在瓦尔蒙特宅邸内避开佣兵和工人的视线实施谋杀，也是很难做到的。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
No, the mercenaries didn't even know it was a person from the government. Even the body was found late.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
不，佣兵甚至不知道那是政府的人。而且尸体也是很久之后才被发现的。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It wasn't the mercenaries.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
不是佣兵干的。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It would have been a difficult to avoid the eyes of the mercenaries' and workers in the Varmundt Mansion.
But, the mercenaries are not the culprit.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
要在瓦尔蒙特宅邸内避开佣兵和工人的视线是很困难的。
但凶手不是佣兵。

scripts.text: It's probably the mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 可能是佣兵

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Are you saying that we're lying? Even after listening to the managers?!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你是在说我们在撒谎吗？明明已经听了管理员的话！

scripts.text: There must have been a traitor among the mercenaries.
scripts.translation: 佣兵中肯定有内鬼。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'm sure there's enough evidence for you to say that.
Now, show us the evidence.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你肯定有足够的证据才敢这么说吧。
现在，把证据拿出来。

scripts.text: H's suspicious behavior.
scripts.translation: 他可疑的行为。

scripts.text: Evidence of internal communication with the enterprise.
scripts.translation: 与企业内部通讯的证据。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... But there's no evidence.
Right now, we can't rely on suspicions. We need proof, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...但是没有证据。
现在，我们不能只凭怀疑。我们需要证据，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Thats... No, it's an envelope with the corporate's seal on it. It's badly crumpled. Where did you get this envelope? It's an item that's strictly forbidden to leak outside of Rekenber.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
那个...不，那是一个盖着公司印章的信封。它被揉得很皱。你从哪里拿到这个信封的？这是严禁泄露到雷肯贝尔之外的物品。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Look at the contents of the envelope. That's what's important.
It's been a long time since I've last read, but I can read it perfectly, like it's a command book.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
看看信封里的内容。那才是重要的。
虽然我很久没读了，但我能完美地读懂它，就像读命令书一样。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I've asked someone to 'dispose' of the government personnel to prevent contact with the mercenaries... And I told him to break inside Varmundt Mansion and steal Varmundt's research data...
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我让人“处理”了政府人员，以防止他们与佣兵接触...还让他潜入瓦尔蒙特宅邸，偷取瓦尔蒙特的研究数据...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's signed by the recipient, 'H. Luckenberg
It's a proof of the identity of the traitor that you mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
上面有收件人的签名，“H. Luckenberg”。
这是你提到的内鬼身份的证明。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
..........

[Dien]
Corporate representative, You don't look so well.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
公司代表，你看起来不太好。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
...I need some time, I have something that I want to check.
I'll get in touch with my secretary, please continue without me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
...我需要一点时间，我有件事想确认一下。
我会联系我的秘书，请你们继续。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, Hey. Mr. Kaya was quite depressed. do you mind checking on Mr. Kaya?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒险者，嘿。卡雅先生看起来很沮丧。你介意去看看卡雅先生吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It's always for something bad to happen at times like this...
I'd be reassured if could take a look at the <NAVI>[garden]<INFO>ba_maison,103,92,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
这种时候总是会发生坏事...
如果我能去看看<NAVI>[花园]<INFO>ba_maison,103,92,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，我会安心一些。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I hope you're not thinking that we're stuck.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我希望你没想到我们被困住了。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Is there anything else suspicious about the mercenary?
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
关于那个佣兵，还有什么可疑的地方吗？

scripts.text: Tell about various suspicious activities.
scripts.translation: 讲述各种可疑行为。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
From the mercenaries' perspective, he was suspicious.
However, it seems only a few people knew about it, and they believe each other, so the whole thing was not revealed.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
从佣兵的角度来看，他确实很可疑。
然而，似乎只有少数人知道这件事，而且他们彼此信任，所以整件事并没有被揭露。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
That's entirely the mercenary's mistake.
I would have known if I had a doubt and poked more into it.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
这完全是佣兵的失误。
如果我当时有怀疑并深入调查，我早就知道了。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
If we found out more about 'H. Luckenberg' at that time...
The Mercenary War might have ended differently.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
如果我们当时能更多地了解“H. Luckenberg”...
佣兵战争可能会有不同的结局。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I'm glad to know the truth.
The government offered an aid, but they were stopped by the companies...
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
得知真相我很欣慰。
政府曾提供援助，但被公司阻止了...

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I apologize for not listening to your plead.
You weren't making false evidence. You just didn't know the truth.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
抱歉没有听取您的辩解。
您并没有伪造证据，只是当时并不知道真相。

scripts.text:
[Tess]
I also want to apologize, for not believing your side of the story and forcing the evidence that we have brought.
scripts.translation:
[泰丝]
我也很抱歉，没有相信您的一面之词，并强行提交了我们的证据。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
..........
I'm sorry for leaving suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
..........
抱歉突然离开。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Something came in to my mind, and I checked it.
I'd like to tell you something what I have found out on my side.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我想起了一些事情，便去核实了一下。
我想告诉您我在这一侧发现的情况。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
What is it?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
是什么？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
On the corporate's employee directory... there is someone who has an exact match of H. Luckenberg's activity during that time.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
在公司的员工名录中...有一人的活动轨迹与H. Luckenberg在那段时间的活动完全吻合。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
He was recorded as a returning employee from a long business trip during the mercenary war.
However, the place he went to was not documented.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
记录显示，他在佣兵战争期间从长期的出差中返回。
然而，他出差的地点并未被记录在案。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
My secretary, Grey, searched through an incomplete records and found this note among the remaining work log memos.
'As fast as possible (Traces of erased memo) lead them to the mansion'
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我的秘书格雷在查阅不完整的记录时，在剩余的工作日志备忘中发现了这条笔记。
“尽快（有被擦除的备忘痕迹）将他们引向庄园”

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
The subject of the memo is vaguely written but it can be clearly understood.
That, he was in Varmundt Mansion...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
备忘的主题写得比较模糊，但意思很清楚。
那就是，他当时在瓦尔蒙特庄园...

scripts.text:
[Dien]
So that's what happened.
The government and mercenaries have been played by the companies again.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
原来如此。
政府和佣兵再次被公司利用了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
It's a shame...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
真是遗憾...

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
All contextual, and material evidence evidence leads to the corporate.
This is, really, a shame.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
所有的背景信息和物证都指向公司。
这真的令人遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I am sorry.
As the Vice President, I feel responsible for all of this.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我很抱歉。
作为副总裁，我对这一切负有责任。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Well... Mr. Corporate Representative, what's the difference between you feeling responsible at this point?
If you apologized, will it bring the dead back?
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
嗯...公司代表先生，现在才感到责任又有什么用呢？
如果您道歉，死者就能复活吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I will take full responsibility for everything, starting by not forgetting the past.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我将承担全部责任，首先从不忘却过去开始。

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
The past? No. It's about what's happening now, the present time. Those Rebellion kids and those who are still sick at Cor are happening now.
Everything you say of the past continues to this day.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
过去？不。重要的是现在，当下正在发生的事。那些反叛者的小孩，以及那些在柯尔仍然患病的人，都是现在正在发生的。
您所说的过去，一直延续到了今天。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
What are going to do now? You can apologize as much as you want. But it's hard to change people's mind.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
您现在打算怎么做？您可以随意道歉。但改变人们的心意很难。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
Let's stop talking about this now. I don't want to talk to you anymore if you continue to repeat the words of taking responsibility without even saying what you're planning to do.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
让我们先停止谈论这个。如果您继续只说承担责任，却不说明打算做什么，我不想再和您说话了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
But, Elder........
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
但是，长老........

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
When you talk proudly like that, it's better not to do it pitifully.
Hohoho, Then I'm off too.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
既然要表现得那么自豪，就别一副可怜兮兮的样子。
呵呵呵，那我也走了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Recently, I'm thinking for a lot of things.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
最近，我思考了很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
I don't have the luxury, to listen to your stories.
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
我可没那个闲工夫听你唠叨。

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
由于您携带的物品过多，无法再接收任何物品。请在减轻负重后重试。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
To think you're really going to take out the liver and gallbladder for everyone.
The corporate is ashamed of you.
scripts.translation:
[???]
没想到你真的打算为所有人取出肝脏和胆囊。
公司为你感到羞耻。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
?!?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
！？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Who are you. Why are you hiding in a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你是谁？为什么躲在这种地方？

scripts.text:
[???]
Vice President, I'm with the Rekenber's Board. ...... You don't need to know my identity.
scripts.translation:
[???]
副总裁，我是来自雷肯贝尔董事会的。......你不需要知道我的身份。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
You rude...! This is not a place for anyone to come and go. Why did you sneak and look for me?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你太无礼了...！这里不是谁都能随意进出的地方。你为什么偷偷摸摸地找过来？

scripts.text:
[???]
The corporate is worried about the Vice President's action. How long are you going to be swayed by their eloquence? What would you do if a representative of the corporate repeatedly acts againt the interest of the corporate?
scripts.translation:
[???]
公司很担心副总裁的所作所为。你还要被他们的花言巧语迷惑多久？如果公司的代表反复做出损害公司利益的行为，你会怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Act against the corporate's interest, I'm always working for the benefit of the corporate.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
损害公司利益？我一直都在为公司利益工作。

scripts.text:
[???]
Let's pick one. Excessive promise of compensation for an accident, overestimation of corporate responsibility.
You're hurting not only the corporate's finances but also its reputation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
随便挑一个吧。对事故进行过度的赔偿承诺，或者高估公司的责任。
你不仅损害了公司的财务，也损害了它的声誉。

scripts.text:
[???]
Why would the corporate compensate for an accident caused by the Illusions?
Rather, it should be the corporate that should receive compensation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
为什么公司要赔偿由<黑暗搜集者>幻觉造成的事故？
相反，应该是公司获得赔偿才对。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Is there a problem when I promised the welfare benefits of the corporate to those who we hired and working under the name of the corporate?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我承诺给那些受雇于我们、以公司名义工作的人提供福利，这有问题吗？

scripts.text:
[???]
You're giving too much benefits.
At this rate, more and more people will want to extort money from the corporate for various reasons.
scripts.translation:
[???]
你给的福利太多了。
照这样下去，会有越来越多的人因为各种理由想从公司那里敲诈钱财。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I don't think all of that is too much.
I'm just doing what we have to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我不觉得那些太多了。
我只是在做我们必须做的事。

scripts.text:
[???]
Phew...... If I had been through with you, I wouldn't have come. That's it. I didn't come here to have a conversation anyway.
scripts.translation:
[???]
呼......如果我已经和你谈妥了，我就不会来了。就这样吧。我本来也不是来跟你聊天的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
What do you mean?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
你什么意思？

scripts.text:
[???]
A conversation is meaningless. It's time for you to disappear from this place!
scripts.translation:
[???]
谈话没有意义。是时候让你从这个地方消失了！

scripts.text: It's dangerous!
scripts.translation: 很危险！

scripts.text:
[Dien]
It's dangerous!
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
很危险！

scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
I've come here to see what's wrong, and looks like a rat appeared.
scripts.translation:
[里德什]
我来看看出了什么事，看起来出现了一只老鼠。

scripts.text:
[Cotnes]
Who are you! I'm not going to let you go!
scripts.translation:
[科特内斯]
你是谁！我不会让你走的！

scripts.text:
[???]
Shit, were you caught?! By these uselessly sharp old people!
scripts.translation:
[???]
该死，你被抓住了吗？被这些老不死的家伙抓住！

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Do, thank you for your help, Elders. It's... It's a job I've devoted my while life to. And the corporate sent an assassin to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
多亏了你们，长老们。这...这是我毕生致力于的事业。而公司派了一名刺客来杀我。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I won't lose though.
The only path for the corporate is clearing the past and improving the present.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
但我不会输的。
公司唯一的路就是清算过去，改善现在。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I won't lose though.
The only path for the corporate is clearing the past and improving the present.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
但我不会输的。
公司唯一的路就是清算过去，改善现在。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Understood. I'm going to contact the company and ask for an important person to talk more deeply with the government and the Rebellions.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
明白了。我会联系公司，请一位重要人物与政府和反叛者进行深入会谈。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
We should investigate this incident properly and catch the culprit.
Thank you again for your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我们应该彻底调查这起事件，抓住罪魁祸首。
再次感谢你们的配合。

scripts.text:
[Dien]
You must have been very surprised, but I gave my thanks to you for proceeding quickly.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
你肯定吓了一跳，但我感谢你们迅速采取行动。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
Then let's return to the tea house. I also want to calm down a little.
Elders, will you come with me?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
那我们回茶馆吧。我也想冷静一下。
长老们，你们愿意跟我一起去吗？

scripts.text:
[Dien]
I'd be happy to escort you.
scripts.translation:
[迪恩]
我很乐意护送你们。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I'd be grateful if you would come with us too, adventurer.
Let's have a tea together, while waiting for the important person to come.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
如果你也愿意和我们一起去，我将不胜感激，冒险者。
在等待重要人物到来之前，我们一起喝杯茶吧。

scripts.text:
[Kaya Toss]
I'm here to think for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅·托斯]
我在这里想一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Welcome, honored guest, I'm an automatic doll with an identifier called Yunas.
Of course, I'm standing here to assist any guests that needs it.
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
欢迎，尊贵的客人。我是自动人偶，编号为尤纳斯。
当然，我站在这里是为了协助任何有需要的客人。

scripts.text: I want to ask about past records.
scripts.translation: 我想查询过往记录。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
What record would you like me to check?
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
您想让我查询什么记录？

scripts.text: Any record of mercenaries is a bell.
scripts.translation: 任何关于佣兵的记录都是铃声。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
I'll prepare the record. Please wait a moment.
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
我会准备记录。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
As the guest requested. I'll deliver random selection of record about mercenaries in the database.
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
按照客人的要求。我将提供数据库中关于佣兵的随机记录。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
How did we get here?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我们是怎么到这里的？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A mansion... of someone you never knew.
I have never been in a mansion like this before.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
这是一座豪宅...属于一个你从未听说过的人。
我以前从未见过这样的豪宅。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What kind of person is Varmundt, who accepted us willingly?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
瓦尔蒙特是个什么样的人，竟然愿意接纳我们？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Oh, you should've asked who it is.
Aren't you the one who saved us when we thought we're all going to die?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
哦，你本该问问他是谁。
难道不是他在我们以为都要死的时候救了我们吗？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Yes, we're alive thanks to Mr. Varmundt and Mr. H
If Mr.H hadn't asked us to come here, we'd all be dead by now.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
是的，多亏了瓦尔蒙特先生和H先生，我们还活着。
如果H先生没有让我们来这里，我们现在肯定都死了。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Let's regain our strength here and prepare for the fight.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
让我们在这里恢复体力，为战斗做准备。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Do you have any more records you'd want to take a look at?
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
您还想查看其他记录吗？

scripts.text: I'm curious about the guy named Mr. H.
scripts.translation: 我对那个叫H先生的人很好奇。

scripts.text: No more.
scripts.translation: 没有了。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Thank you for reading the records!
If you need any more records, please do not hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
感谢您查阅记录！
如果您还需要其他记录，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
... I think I've finally calm down.
Everyone was furious.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
...我想我终于冷静下来了。
当时大家都非常愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
But it was something that had to be done.
People simply died like that, people... There was blood everywhere and their eyes turned over.
Now that I think about it, I deeply regret it.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
但那是不得不做的事。
人们就这样死了，人们...到处都是血，他们的眼睛翻白。
现在回想起来，我深感后悔。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
We used the substitute plan and we took more casualty than we should have.
I should have stopped Mr. H.
Everyone started yelling and panicking that we had to get rid of them first...
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我们使用了备用计划，结果伤亡比预想的要多。
我本该阻止H先生的。
大家开始大喊大叫，惊慌失措，说必须先解决他们...

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Neither Mr.H and we are not so bled up back then.
Don't blame Mr.H too much.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
当时H先生和我们都没有受太重的伤。
不要过多责怪H先生。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Well, that's true... Let's stop talking about, dwelling on it will just be hard on us.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
嗯，确实如此...让我们别再提这件事了，一直纠结于此只会让我们更难受。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Do you have any more records you'd want to take a look at?
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
您还想查看其他记录吗？

scripts.text: I'm done.
scripts.translation: 我读完了。

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Thank you for reading the records!
If you need any more records, please do not hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
感谢您查阅记录！
如果您还需要其他记录，请随时告诉我。

scripts.text: - I need to remember what I heard carefully. -
scripts.translation: - 我需要仔细记住我听到的内容。 -

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Welcome to the Varmundt Mansion. The Varmundt Mansion provides various benefits such as medical services, shopping and entertainment, and leisure activities...
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
欢迎来到瓦尔蒙特豪宅。瓦尔蒙特豪宅提供多种服务，如医疗服务、购物和娱乐，以及休闲活动...

scripts.text:
[Yunas]
Uh. Oops. This is not it. I have mistakenly told you the wrong thing.
Please disregard it...
scripts.translation:
[尤纳斯]
呃。哎呀。这不是我要说的。我错误地告诉了你别的事情。
请忽略刚才的话...

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Do you want any records from a guest from the past?
Do you have a specific record in mind?
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
您想要查看过去客人的记录吗？
您有特定的记录想要查看吗？

scripts.text: Any record of incidents and accidents.
scripts.translation: 任何关于事故和意外的记录。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Let me check for a moment...
Record is randomly selected from the incedent and accident category.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
请稍等，让我查一下...
记录将从事故和意外类别中随机选取。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Incident, record 5872, confirmed.
I'll play back the records of that time.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
事故，记录编号5872，已确认。
我将回放当时的记录。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A body was found near the wall of the mansion.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
在豪宅的墙边发现了一具尸体。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What's that horrible story?
Whose body is it?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
这是什么可怕的故事？
那是谁的尸体？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Well, no one knows. Even the managers doesn't know.
The body was neatly dressed, and doesn't look like a mercenary at all.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
嗯，没人知道。连管理员都不知道。
尸体穿着整齐，完全不像佣兵的样子。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Do you think they're already here?
But the corporate people aren't going to dress up and visit us.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
你觉得他们已经来了吗？
但公司的人不会打扮成那样来拜访我们。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I know, it's just an apparition that's grumbling,
I hope it's not a big deal...
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我知道，那只是个抱怨的幽灵，
希望不是什么大事...

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
The record playback has finished.
Do you need any information about other records?
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
记录回放结束。
您需要其他记录的信息吗？

scripts.text: I need more information about the body.
scripts.translation: 我需要更多关于尸体的信息。

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Please wait a moment, gender is female, name is unidentified and she was wearing a gray suit, but very disheveled with blood.
The cause of death was an attack from behind... then...
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
请稍等，性别为女性，姓名未识别，她穿着灰色西装，但非常凌乱且沾有血迹。
死因是背后受袭...然后...

scripts.text: - I received a records of an unknown body. -
scripts.translation: - 我收到了一具不明尸体的记录。 -

scripts.text:
[Skippy]
Hello, there. Do you need a record of the past guests?
The guest list is recorded in a huge database.
scripts.translation:
[斯基皮]
你好。您需要过去客人的记录吗？
客人名单记录在一个巨大的数据库中。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Hello, guest. Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
你好，客人。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Records about the mercenaries in the past.
scripts.translation: 关于过去佣兵的记录。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
There's a lot of record about past guests, what kind of records do you need?
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
过去客人的记录有很多，您需要哪种记录？

scripts.text: About a mercenary named H.
scripts.translation: 关于一位名叫H的佣兵。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching, searching... Search complete. There are a very few records about Mr. H...
However, there are many records of what others said about Mr. H.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
正在搜索，搜索中...搜索完成。关于H先生的记录非常少...
不过，有很多关于其他人对H先生评价的记录。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
If you want to read about the record, I will prepare it for you.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
如果您想阅读这些记录，我会为您准备好。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
By the way, where's Mr. H?
I've been looking for him for a while, but...
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
顺便问一下，H先生在哪里？
我找了他好一会儿，但是...

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
It seems his away often.
I have to talk to him someday. What if the corporates suddenly comes in.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
他似乎经常不在。
我得找机会和他谈谈。万一公司的人突然来了怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Not long ago, I saw Mr. H talking with someone I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
不久前，我看到H先生和一个我不认识的人在交谈。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
A person you don't know, where would you find a person a random person here?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
你不认识的人？在这种地方，你上哪儿去找一个陌生人？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
That's why it's weird. He was also thoroughly checking the perimeter, but I'm good at hiding.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
这就是奇怪的地方。他还在仔细检查周围，但我很擅长隐匿。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
What did they talk about?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
他们聊了什么？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I didn't hear it because it was too far.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
因为距离太远，我没听清。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
You didn't hide well, you were just far away!
Anyway, that's really suspicious. What the hell is going on?
..................
..................
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
你只是躲得不够好，离得远而已！
总之，这真的很可疑。到底发生了什么？
...........
..........

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Record out is complete.
Do you need more information about H.?
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
记录输出完成。
您需要更多关于H先生的信息吗？

scripts.text: H's conversation with the stranger.
scripts.translation: H先生与陌生人的对话

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching... no results found. We don't have any record of that information.
This record was recorded by a cleaning robot and the manager without ears.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
正在搜索...未找到结果。我们没有该信息的记录。
这条记录是由清洁机器人和没有耳朵的管理员记录的。

scripts.text: The place where the conversation was recorded.
scripts.translation: 对话发生的位置

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Searching... Through the records of the cleaning robot, I can guide you to the last recognized location at that record.
I will give you the coordinate. Please follow this <NAVI>[guide]<INFO>ba_maison,357,291,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
正在搜索...通过清洁机器人的记录，我可以指引您前往该记录中最后识别到的位置。
我将提供坐标。请跟随<NAVI>[向导]<INFO>ba_maison,357,291,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
Hello, there. How can I help you?
I am really glad to assist any guest.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
您好。有什么可以帮您的吗？
我很乐意协助任何客人。

scripts.text:
[Adore]
You should do anything to please me!
Yes, I am created that way.
scripts.translation:
[阿多尔]
您应该做任何事来取悦我！
是的，我就是被这样创造出来的。

scripts.text: - Do you remember any of the guests' conversations? -
scripts.translation: - 您还记得任何客人的对话吗？ -

scripts.text:
[Nono]
You mean the old guests?
Of course I remember everything!
What story would you like to hear? I'll tell you all about it!
scripts.translation:
[诺诺]
您是指以前的客人？
我当然记得所有事情！
您想听哪个故事？我会告诉您所有的！

scripts.text:
[Nono]
I have searched the database for past guests' conversations, the records are selected randomly!
Here are the following results!
scripts.translation:
[诺诺]
我已经在数据库中搜索了过往客人的对话，记录是随机选择的！
以下是搜索结果！

scripts.text: Someone's Travel.
scripts.translation: 某人的旅行

scripts.text: Traces of Discovery.
scripts.translation: 发现的痕迹

scripts.text: Goverment Criticism.
scripts.translation: 对政府的批评

scripts.text:
[Nono]
I'll play the record!
scripts.translation:
[诺诺]
我要播放记录了！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There is a mercenary who was almost thrown out while trying to go deep into the mansion. Who is it?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
有个佣兵在试图深入宅邸时差点被赶出去。他是谁？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I think it was Mr. H. Why would he do such a thing.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我觉得是H先生。他为什么要这么做。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Yeah. The supply that was provided to us are enough to get by already.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
是啊。提供给我们的补给已经够用了。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Did H. needed more Barmeal Tickets?
Even if he didn't need it, I would still have shared it to him if he asked.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
H先生需要更多的霸肋门德餐券吗？
即使他不需要，只要他开口，我也会分给他的。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I'm suspicious of Mr. H. Don't you think he's only doing that stands out?
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我对H先生很怀疑。你不觉得他总是在出风头吗？

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Come on, don't say that. We should trust each other.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
别这么说。我们应该互相信任。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Another suspicious trace was found near the mansion.
This time, someone said it's the trace of a fierce battle, but none of us got hurt or went missing.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
在宅邸附近又发现了一个可疑的痕迹。
这次有人说那是激烈战斗的痕迹，但我们没有人受伤或失踪。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I've heard it too. It must have been those corporate guys! We musn't stay here and clean up out there.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我也听说了。肯定是那些公司的人！我们不能留在这里，得去外面清理一下。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
Calm down. You don't even know what happened, do you?
No one was hurt but they found a lot of blood stains. The leaders are still investigating it.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
冷静点。你甚至不知道发生了什么，不是吗？
没有人受伤，但发现了很多血迹。首领们还在调查中。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
How can we not know anything when there is a lot of mess happening out there. I'm so frustrating, very frustrating!!
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
外面发生这么多混乱，我们怎么可能什么都不知道。太让人沮丧了，非常沮丧！！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
I thought that the goverment will mediate in the case of an incident, but it's as if we didn't exist in the goverment's eyes.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
我以为政府会在发生事故时进行调解，但在政府眼里，我们好像根本不存在。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There's no movement at all, let alone mediation.
Are we not citizens? How could they do this!
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
他们毫无动静，更别提调解了。
我们不是市民吗？他们怎么能这样！

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
There's been a lot of bloodshed, and such big commotions.
If the government doesn't come forward at times like this, someone has to step up and advance the government forward.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
发生了这么多流血事件，还有这么大的骚动。
如果政府在这种时候不站出来，就得有人站出来推动政府前进。

scripts.text:
[Mercenary]
But no one's stepping up. The government is not like a real government, it's not moving forward at all.
scripts.translation:
[佣兵]
但没有人站出来。政府不像个真正的政府，完全没有任何进展。

scripts.text:
[Nono]
My name is Nono, and I want to fly high in the sky.
I was named Nono because I want to be called that way.
scripts.translation:
[诺诺]
我叫诺诺，我想在天空飞得更高。
我之所以叫诺诺，是因为我想被这样称呼。

scripts.text: - A little away from the reception area, a cleaning robot lies discharged in the shadow. It seems like it's been here for a very long time. -
scripts.translation: - 离接待区不远处，一个清洁机器人倒在阴影里，似乎已经很久没动了。 -

scripts.text: - I turned it upside down and it's stopped because of a little paper envelope stucked in it. -
scripts.translation: - 我把它翻过来，发现里面卡着一个小小的信封，导致它停摆了。 -

scripts.text: - Is this a Rekenber's pattern on the envelope? Why are these things here?
scripts.translation: - 信封上有雷肯贝尔的图案吗？这些东西为什么会在这里？

scripts.text: - Carefully, I took out the envelope to not tear it. -
scripts.translation: - 我小心翼翼地取出信封，以免弄破它。 -

scripts.text:
^008800Wait a sec!!
You cannot receive any more items because you're carrying too many items. Please try again after you lighten up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^008800等一下！！
由于您携带的物品过多，无法再接收任何物品。请在减轻负重后重试。^000000

scripts.text: The body of Manager Beta is hidden under the landscapes.
scripts.translation: 管理员贝塔的遗体隐藏在风景之下。

scripts.text:
I've recovered the core.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
Let's look for more.
scripts.translation:
核心已经回收了。
稍后我会通知Alpha，让她来取回玩偶的躯体。
我们继续寻找吧。

scripts.text:
I've recovered the core.
I'll let Alpha know later so she can retrieve the doll's body.
I've recovered enough cores.
scripts.translation:
核心已经回收了。
稍后我会通知Alpha，让她来取回玩偶的躯体。
我已经回收了足够的核心。

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
由于您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。
请整理您的背包后重试。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Hey, adventurer, this way. Did you get any results?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嘿，冒险者，这边请。有结果了吗？

scripts.text: Why, Elena?
scripts.translation: 为什么，埃琳娜？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Lucky asked me a favor.
Elyumina seems to have been attacked again.
I just happen to be nearby at the time and somehow pull her out from that predicament.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
拉基拜托了我一件事。
艾露米娜似乎又遇袭了。
我刚好在附近，不知怎么就把她从那个困境中救了出来。

scripts.text: Show her the cores.
scripts.translation: 给她看看核心

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Did you found anything unusual?
I've already searched a lot of places in the mansion, and all of it were empty.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
你发现什么异常了吗？
我已经搜遍了宅邸的很多地方，但那里都是空的。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
What, so did you?
How do these guys avoid our eyes and keep making trouble?
It's very annoying.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
什么，你也发现了？
这些家伙是怎么躲过我们的视线，还一直搞事的？
真是烦人。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What is this!!!!
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
这是什么！！

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Hey, suspicious guy, you're that guy, right?
You look exactly like guy that I missed at the lab last time.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嘿，可疑的家伙，就是你吧？
你长得跟上次我在实验室漏掉的那个人一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'm very lucky. How did a big fish like you ended up here?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我真走运。像你这样的大鱼怎么会落到这里？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What, the mercenaries really became the dogs of the republic aren't they?
You already destroyed my lab. What else do I need to do?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
什么，雇佣兵真的成了共和国的走狗了吗？
你们已经毁了我的实验室。我还得做什么？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I don't have anything to say to you, so just let me go.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
我没什么话要跟你说，放我走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Stop opening your filthy mouth.
Ha, My personality has already died a long time ago.
Uh, take this guy as prisoner, uh and keep him alive.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
闭上你那张肮脏的嘴。
哈，我的个性早就死掉了。
呃，把这个家伙抓起来当囚犯，呃，留他一条命。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What do you want from me?
Seyren failed because of that adventurer.
Was he a hopeless failure too?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你想从我这里得到什么？
塞伦的失败是因为那个冒险者。
他也是个没用的废物吗？

scripts.text: Is it right to talk about experiments in this situation?
scripts.translation: 在这种时候谈论实验合适吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
What's left if you take the research and the experiments out of me?
Stop asking the obvious.
All right. I won't fall for your provocation. Instead I'll ask you one thing.
If you answer me, I am willing to cooperate with you in response.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
如果拿掉研究和实验，我还剩下什么？
别问这种显而易见的问题。
好吧。我不会上你的激将法。相反，我要问你一件事。
如果你回答我，我愿意配合你。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
You're not in the position to negotiate, are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
你现在没有资格跟我谈判，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Damn it! I won't run away, so stop!
Where did the guys from Cor go?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
该死！我不会逃跑的，住手！
柯尔的那些人去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
(This guy, why would he be curious about that? It looks like he came here to join his colleagues late... Wouldn't we know where the others are if we successfully talk it out?)
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
（这家伙，为什么会好奇那个？看起来像是来和同事们会合的...如果我们能顺利谈妥，应该知道其他人都在哪里吧？）

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Why are you being so quiet? Did you already disposed them?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你为什么不说话？你已经把他们处理掉了吗？

scripts.text: She is currently held captive.
scripts.translation: 她目前被扣押着。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Really? Then take me there.
I don't want to wander around this crappy garden anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
真的吗？那就带我去。
我不想再在这个破花园里乱转了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
You look so arrogant, don't you?
I don't know what you're planning, but I Elena Bolkova will take you.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
你看起来真傲慢啊。
我不知道你在打什么算盘，但我，埃琳娜·博尔科娃，会带你去的。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I'm willing to come with you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
我愿意跟你走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
What a weird guy. I'll take this guy with me. Rookie is probably there too.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
真是个怪人。我就带上这家伙吧。新人应该也在那里。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Huh? Where will I bring this guy?
Ah, the guesthouse. We are currently using it as a prison.
Follow me. Also, I'll take all the cores with me.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嗯？我要带这家伙去哪里呢？
啊，是招待所。我们目前把它当作监狱使用。
跟我来。另外，我会把所有核心都带走。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'll see you at the guesthouse.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我在招待所等你。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
I'm watching the area to see if there are hidden enemies lurking around.
There are a lot of blind spots in this place.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
我正在监视周围，看是否有潜伏的敌人。
这里有很多死角。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There is nothing particular here.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
这里没什么特别的。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Are you going in?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
你要进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I'll stay here and keep this place safe.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我会留在这里，确保这里的安全。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Oh, here you are, this way, is Lucky not here yet?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
哦，你来了，这边请。拉基还没到吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
No, no, I'm here too. Am a bit late?
I talked to Alpha for a moment.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不，不，我也在这里。我迟到了吗？
我和阿尔法聊了一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who is that?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那是谁？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
A big catch?
Just watch. It's a sight for these two to play.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
是个大人物？
看着吧。这对那两个人来说是个好机会。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Hey, this is different from what we've talked about.
Who is this?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
嘿，这和我们之前谈的不一样。
这人是谁？

scripts.text: That's the guy in Cor that you've mentioned.
scripts.translation: 那是你提到的柯尔的人。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
This kid? I can't recall...?
Are you lying to me?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
这个小孩？我不记得...？
你在骗我吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Who are you to treat me like that?!
Are you a dog of those punks?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你凭什么这样对我？！
你是那些朽魔的狗吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
They betrayed me first, and they're calling me a traitor.
Are you with those punks?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
明明是他们先背叛了我，现在却叫我叛徒。
你是和那些朽魔一伙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
I can't believe it, Is this really the Illusion?
No, are you really a member of the Illusion?
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
难以置信，这真的是<黑暗搜集者>的幻觉吗？
不，你真的是<黑暗搜集者>的成员吗？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
What the hell are you talking about?! Why would I be held here when I'm not even one of the Illusion!
What should I do, You didn't recognize the Great Elyumina. Do you want me to hit your head?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你在胡说八道什么？！我明明不是<黑暗搜集者>的人，为什么要被关在这里！
我该怎么办，你竟然认不出伟大的艾露米娜。要不要我敲爆你的头？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Hey, Rebellion, I need you to change this one to something that talks properly.
If you want any information from me, bring me a decent Illusion member.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
嘿，反叛者，我需要你把这家伙变成说话正常一点的样子。
如果你想从我这里得到任何资讯，就给我带来一个像样的<黑暗搜集者>成员。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
No, did you wuss out just now?
Hey, I've been telling you that I'm a member of the Illusion for a while now. Do you even know how many years I've been doing this for?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
不，你刚才是在退缩吗？
嘿，我早就告诉过你我就是<黑暗搜集者>的成员。你知道我干这行多少年了吗？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
(See, isn't it funny? Watching them fight like that.)
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
（看，是不是很有趣？看他们这样争吵。）

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
(Do you think it's an internal division? Come to think of it, you said he was the director of the research facility of the previous operation, right? How was he captured by us?)
scripts.translation:
[新人]
（你觉得这是内部分裂吗？仔细想想，你说过他是前次行动研究设施的总监，对吧？他是怎么被我们抓到的？）

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
You are lacking something important, you don't have a 'chip'!
If only the 'chip' was detected, I wouldn't have come in here, and I would never have met a con like you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
你缺少了重要的东西，你没有“芯片”！
如果检测到了“芯片”，我就不会进来了，也绝不会遇到你这种骗子。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
The Illusion is an alliance, but it's like a structure of thought. The official members has a 'chip' planted in their body, it's use to recognize traitors like you.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
<黑暗搜集者>是一个联盟，但更像是一种思想结构。正式成员体内植入了“芯片”，用来识别像你这样的叛徒。

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Unless that 'chip' exist in you, you're not one of the Illusion. Do you get it now? You kid.
scripts.translation:
[艾森]
除非你体内存在那个“芯片”，否则你就不是<黑暗搜集者>的人。你明白了吗？你这小孩。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Ho? Did you hear that, Rookie? It's called 'chip'.
This stupid thing blew it all out of his mouth.
Fucking bastards, they left me alone.
You mean, I who were in the middle of it all, were just a pawn, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
哦？你听到了吗，新人？那叫“芯片”。
这个蠢货把一切都说漏嘴了。
该死的混蛋，他们把我一个人丢在这里。
你的意思是，我身处其中，却只是一个棋子，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eisen]
Wa... wait...!

[Elyumina]
Is it too late to make a stupid expression now?
Are you a self proclaimed elite member of the Illusion?
Rookie! I'll rip this off his neck and make a tracker to trace those 'chips'!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
现在露出愚蠢的表情还来得及吗？
你是自封的<黑暗搜集者>精英成员吗？
新人！我要把他的脖子拧下来，做一个追踪器来追踪那些“芯片”！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Yeah! Let's do it! Revenge on the traitors! Chaos! Destruction! Revenge! Fall!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
好！就这么办！向叛徒复仇！混沌！毁灭！复仇！坠落！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
How dare you play with me?
How dare you ignore the Great Elyumina, the line is very short, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你竟敢戏弄我？
你竟敢无视伟大的艾露米娜，界限是很短的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Fuahahahahaha!!!!
No, what am I seeing?!!!
I thought our teamwork was good, but we're not as good as our enemies?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！！！
不，我看到了什么？！！！
我以为我们的团队合作很好，但我们还不如我们的敌人？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I know.
Mina, what are you going to do now?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我知道。
米娜，你打算怎么做？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
To guarantee my research rights, I'm going to make you something you'd like.
No, I just can't stand being harassed like this just because I'm a traitor, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
为了保证我的研究权利，我要给你做点你喜欢的东西。
不，我只是无法忍受仅仅因为我是叛徒就被这样骚扰，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I'll investigate the 'chip' planted in this guy's body and create a tracker that respond to this 'chip'.
I've been building something before to protect myself from those hearthunters.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我会调查植入这家伙体内的“芯片”，并创建一个能响应这个“芯片”的追踪器。
我之前为了保护自己免受那些猎心者的侵害，一直在构建一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I wouldn't have gone this far too if I didn't protect my own life.
Anyway, Please get me some materials that I need while I'm trying to rip off this guy. what's this guy called again, Eisen?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
如果不是为了保命，我也不会走到这一步。
总之，趁我拆掉这家伙身上的东西时，请帮我弄些材料。这家伙叫什么来着，艾森？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What materials do you need?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你需要什么材料？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
10 Fluorescent Liquid, 10 Broken Sword, and some modules...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
10个荧光色的液体，10把破裂之剑，还有一些模块...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Do you need that many? I hope you're not thinking about something stupid. I'll get the modules from Cor.
Adventurer, could you get us the Fluorescent Liquids and Broken Swords?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
需要那么多吗？希望你没在打什么坏主意。我去柯尔拿模块。
冒险者，你能帮我们弄荧光色的液体和破裂之剑吗？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I think I've seen a fluorescent liquid in the sewage treatment plant, you can get it if you catch a black colored heart hunter scout.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我记得在污水处理厂见过荧光色的液体，捕捉黑色的心之猎手侦察兵就能得到。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Then I'll stay here and protect this place, and when he wakes up, shouldn't someone stay here and knock him out again?
You two, can leave it to me. Don't worry about this place.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
那我先留在这里保护这个地方。等他醒来，总得有人留在这里再把他打晕吧？
你们两个，这里就交给我了。不用担心这里。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Erst is probably right in the front lounge.
Go ahead and meet with Erst first, and I'll join later.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
厄斯特大概就在前面的休息区。
你们先去见厄斯特吧，我稍后过去。

scripts.text:
[Elena]
Oh, where is Eisen Werner.
He was taken by Tess. It looks like they're going to interrogate him on their own.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
哦，艾森·维尔纳在哪里？
他被泰丝带走了。看起来他们打算单独审问他。

scripts.text:
[Elena]
And he'll be locked up somewhere for the rest of his life.
Elyumina would have been like that too. Elyumina's pretty lucky, right?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
而且他余生都会被关在某个地方。
艾露米娜也会落得那样的下场。艾露米娜挺幸运的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Elena]
Don't worry about this place. I'll keep it safe.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
不用担心这里。我会守好的。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Don't worry about this place. I'm guarding it properly.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
不用担心这里。我正在好好守卫。

scripts.text:
You cannot proceed with the quest because you have too many items in your possession.
Please clean up your inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
由于您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。
请整理您的背包后重试。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Now you're safe, and all you have to do is chase those traitors to the end.
Hahahahaha!! I'll be the winner who survived until the end.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
现在你安全了，你只需要追那些叛徒到底。
哈哈哈哈！！我会是笑到最后的人。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Hmm~ Modules modules~ Hmm~
Cores cores~ Hmm~
What are you doing? Why didn't bring the materials I told you about?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嗯~ 模块模块~ 嗯~
核心核心~ 嗯~
你在干什么？为什么没带我说的那些材料？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Good, good~ Hmm
If you do this here...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
很好，很好~ 嗯
如果在这里做的话...

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
A masterpiece is born!
If you send a signal, the receiver will~
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
杰作诞生了！
只要发送信号，接收器就会~

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
That's a good catch!
Now, with this, go after the remnant of the Heart Hunter and the traitors.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
抓得好！
现在，拿着这个，去追心之猎手的残党和叛徒吧。

scripts.text: By myself?
scripts.translation: 独自去？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Can you do it alone when I'm holding the tracker?
I can't believe I was caught by this guy.
It's a disgrace to me, the great Elyumina.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我拿着追踪器，你能独自去吗？
我竟然被这家伙抓住了。
这对于伟大的艾露米娜来说简直是耻辱。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Huh, how about me if there's no one else to go with?
or Erst.
Didn't you join Erst in the last operation?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
嗯，如果没人陪你去，算我一个？
或者厄斯特。
上次行动你不是和厄斯特一起的吗？

scripts.text: Where is Erst?
scripts.translation: 厄斯特在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
She is probably right in the front lounge.
Didn't you see her when you came?
I'll also take the opportunity to turn them over and join you later.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
她大概就在前厅。
你来的时候没看到她吗？
我也正好趁这个机会把他们交出去，稍后再和你们汇合。

scripts.text:
[Elena Bolkova]
Erst, is good with brainstorm things. Hahahaha.
Go ahead and meet with Erst.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·博尔科娃]
厄斯特很擅长头脑风暴。哈哈。
去和厄斯特会合吧。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I've heard the news. Those bastards.
However, Is it true that all the important Illusion members we're able to run away?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我听到消息了。那群混蛋。
不过，是真的吗？我们抓到的所有重要<黑暗搜集者>成员都逃走了？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
You hid like rats, and you secretly operated at night, right?
Let's see how far they can ran away.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你们像老鼠一样躲藏，在夜间秘密行动，对吧？
让我们看看他们能逃到哪里去。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
*Chuckles*, I'll go find those traitors.
Adventurer, *Chuckles*
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
*轻笑*，我去找那些叛徒。
冒险者，*轻笑*

scripts.text:
[Est]
Adventurer, what's that?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
冒险者，那是什么？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Ho..., a tracker that tells you where the Illusion and Heart Hunters are?
That's a little tempting.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦...，一个能显示<黑暗搜集者>和心之猎手位置的追踪器？
这有点诱人呢。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Based on their behavior so far, they seem to be working in the dark when the sun sets.
Let's wait until the sun goes down and then proceed to the operation quietly.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
根据他们之前的行为，他们似乎在太阳落山后活动。
让我们等到天黑，然后悄悄开始行动。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'm going to reduce the night patrol drastically today so they can crawl out of their caves.
I'm going to make the exterior of the mansion look empty.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
今天我会大幅减少夜间巡逻，让他们从洞穴里爬出来。
我会让宅邸外面看起来空无一人。

scripts.text:
[Est]
I'll tell the managers about the operation.
Don't wander around the garden at night, it'll be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我会告诉管理员们关于这次行动的事。
晚上不要在花园里乱逛，那很危险。

scripts.text:
[Est]
It's an obvious trap, but I don't think they'll let this opportunity pass by.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
这显然是一个陷阱，但我想他们不会放过这个机会的。

scripts.text:
[Est]
If you have no objection, we'll proceed as it is.
You should get ready for the operation.
Talk to me when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
如果你没有异议，我们就按这个计划进行。
你应该为行动做好准备。
准备好后告诉我。

Please create a party and try again.

scripts.translation:
^0000CD这是一个记忆地下城。^000000
请创建队伍并再次尝试。
^0000CD可以使用 /organize partyname 命令创建队伍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Shall we go?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我们要走了吗？

Enter '{0}'.'

^4D4DFFThis place is a memorial dungeon.
You have to be a party leader to create a memorial dungeon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4D4DFF这是一个记忆地下城。
您必须是队伍首领才能创建记忆地下城。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Then, let's proceed quietly.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
那么，让我们悄悄行动吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's wait out a little longer before going out... We can't be careless.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
让我们再等一会儿再出去...我们不能大意。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We handed the prisoner to Alpha.
By the way, I've prepared a trap to cause a commotion, and to catch the non-officer members.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我们把囚犯交给了阿尔法。
顺便说一下，我准备了一个陷阱来制造混乱，并抓获非军官成员。

scripts.text:
[Est]
They're not easy to catch...
Alpha is going to do some more research on the airship hangar, so go check it out.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
他们不好对付...
阿尔法还要对飞空艇机库做进一步调查，你去看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Let's take a break for now.
Sigh... You did a great job.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
先休息一下吧。
